decision_basis: Two independent Docker canonical-build cycles produced the same zte_tpd.ko SHA-256.
Candidate and stock AArch64 assembly have identical 39 instructions, 156-byte symbol size and resolved relocations.
Candidate and stock KCFI type IDs are identical: 0xe5c47d60.
Strict Joern gate passed with zero parse problems and one-to-one source/Ghidra identity coverage.
The dedicated ASAN/UBSAN contract passed 2/2 cases in both reproducible cycles, covering teardown order, offsets, buffer release and null-buffer handling.
